    Setting 8.4 from a representation-finite ray table #

    Setting 8.4 for a finite ray table P with representation-finite linearization: "Write R_x = k[q_x]/(q_x^{N_x}) when R_x ≠ k, choosing q_x as its homogeneous radical generator", with the endpoint chains of Lemma 3.1(3). The identity vectors of kP are a complete set of primitive orthogonal idempotents; the corners are spanned by rays, and the corner radicals by the local rays of positive degree. By Lemma 3.1(3) (exists_rad_gen) at most one positive local ray at x is not a product of two positive local rays; it generates all local rays (q_x). Every Hom is cyclic over one endpoint (endpointSpan_one_sided) and its endpoint subbimodules form a chain (isChain_subbimodules), which gives the fields cyc and chain of Sys.

    References #

    • Multiplicative bases and deformations of representation-finite algebras, https://github.com/haruhisa-enomoto/multiplicative-bases-deformations. Numbered statements cited here refer to it.
